scope: Diagnostic working-set observation during the third cumulative dashboard timing run
owner: Only descendants of the agent-owned dashboard-viewport.mjs Node process were selected
measurement: Win32_Process.WorkingSetSize divided by 1048576, rounded to one decimal
limitations: A process working set is not live JavaScript heap usage.
This observation does not establish a leak, GC attribution or the cause of a callback stall.
Inspect live/retained heap and callback traces before changing qualification setup or limits.
